text: Binary flag: 1 if at least one comment by a non-OP user (OC_comments, JSON list) explicitly states a specific, checkable real-world factual claim (e.g. statistic, historical event, study finding, law, documented case) that is distinct from facts already in the OP's title/argument (given as context); verification is not performed, judged from text. Opinions, value judgments, purely logical arguments, hypotheticals, and restatements or quotations of OP claims do not count. Returns 0 if the list is valid and no comment qualifies, including an empty list; null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or OP text is missing so distinctness can't be judged. Ignores OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and reports of whether the outcome occurred (even inside argument or comments); generic discussion of delta/platform rules remains eligible. Uses current text only, no reconstruction of snapshots or ordering.
